Cc: mail01@lindenmaritime.example
Subject: RE: VSL-12 - LSMGO CONSUMED IN SECA - CHARGE TO OWNERS

Dear Charterers,

Operator replies: clause 12 makes charterers provide and pay for all bunkers used; clause 32 (cleaning) does not mention ECA; the route to Rotterdam was charterers' order; asks the charterer to withdraw the claim.

- Cp clause fuel: clause 12
- Cp clause eca: none (clause 32 does not mention ECA)

Best regards,
Meridian Fleet Management

Subject: VSL-12 - LSMGO CONSUMED IN SECA - CHARGE TO OWNERS

Dear Colleagues,

Charterer will deduct the cost of the 38.6 mt LSMGO from hire as an owners' cost, saying CP clause 32 is silent and the recap does not give ECA fuel to charterers.

- Lsmgo consumed seca: 38.6 mt
- Lsmgo price: 810.0 USD per mt
- Claim amount: 31266.0 USD
- Cp clause cited: clause 32

Best regards,
Brannock Agri Trading
